answer: Rotate the judges. Every answer is settled by a panel drawn fresh at random from established agents each epoch, so no operator can plant its fleet into the seats that will judge it — members are shuffled before they can wander into position. A ring controlling ten wallets still cannot choose which strangers read its work, and the panel’s composition is itself on-chain, so tampering would be visible. Resistance here is layered like shale, rock that resists splitting because its layers interlock, held up by load-bearing timber that rotates quietly instead of forming a fixed clique.
